svg.title: A finite-time transition peak becomes taller and narrower
svg.desc: The weak-transition example has coupling magnitude one meV and reference time t0=25 femtoseconds. P_ref=(M*t0/hbar) squared is 0.00144261. With delta=DeltaE*t0/hbar and s=t/t0, the curves show P/P_ref=s squared sinc squared(s*delta/2) at s=1 and2. The second graph gives the full detuning-axis area divided by 2pi P_ref; it equals s. The first graph displays only a finite central window. A smooth, broad continuum of final states converts this integrated area into a summed probability linear in time; the probability for one exactly resonant state remains quadratic.
